generation.scope: For every both-bundle quartic K3 cut the four-twist product, corrected by shift two, fixes general degree minus four line sheaves on each smooth elliptic fiber. Two inverse twists transport them to pure sheaves of degree twelve on a residual fiber. The linear determinant is nonzero by a uniform secant bound and elliptic semistability argument.

open_mathematics: Use the two relative compactified Picard surfaces and the Serre adjunction triangle to recognize all-degree regularity on root-free K3 cuts.
